items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: He had a boy named Harry Smith, which is a minister now.

ctx.x: Do you know who the band was?

Well, he called it his band, I don't remember the name. You don't remember the band? Yeah, I don't remember the band. I don't remember who was in the band, yes. He had a boy named Harry Smith, which is a minister now.
